Welcome to /v/WhereIsThis, where we use the collective mind of Voaters to find where in the world an image is. This sub serves two purposes. Game, and collective thought.

There will be two kinds of posts in here. PLEASE TAG YOUR POSTS. See below for examples on how to tag (until flair becomes a bigger thing).

---Where is this?: Perhaps you have an interesting picture, but have no idea where it was taken but would like to know. Post it here with any information you do know (if any) and we'll see what we can do. Please include any facts you have either in the thread title, or in the thread itself if you know a lot about the picture.

Example of thread title:

"I know a lot about this picture, but I don't know exactly where it was taken. Facts in comments. Where is this?"

"I know this was taken in Nevada in 1967, but that's all I know. Where is this?"

"I don't even know the language in the picture. Where is this?"

---Challenge: You have a picture, and know exactly where in the world it was taken. Post the image with however many facts you'd like (or not). There are three modes to this, easy, medium, hard. Facts can include signs in the picture.

Easy: 4+ facts. Medium: 2-4 facts Hard: >2 facts

Please include "Challenge (Easy/Medium/Hard)" in the title.

These rules will be evolving as I am still relatively new to this, but find the whole idea interesting. If I delete your thread, I will leave a comment in the thread with my justification. I will try to be as clear as possible, but feel free to message me with any questions.

Most importantly: HAVE FUN. Don't bash. Sharing what you DO know in the thread is allowed. This is meant to be friendly.
